 Shri Manish Naik, Panel lawyer, for the respondent/State.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case diary is available.
This is Eighth application under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of bail.
His earlier applications were dismissed on merits vide order dated 8.9.2021 and 21.2.2022 passed in M.Cr.C.No.44365 of 2021 and 1300 of 2022.

The applicant has been arrested on 4.1.2021 in connection with Crime No. 3/2021 registered at Police Station Pahadgarh district Morena, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 272, 273 of IPC and 51, 57, 59 and 62 of Food Safety Act and standard Act, 2006.

entities.text: Food Safety Act and standard Act, 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that the applicant has been falsely implicated.
It is further submitted that two prosecution witnesses have been examined before the trial court but they have not supported the case of prosecution.
From the date of last rejection, further one and half months custody has been suffered by the applicant and now, he is in custody since 4.1.2021.
There is no progress in trial.
Therefore, considering the custody period which is around 16 months and the offences which are triable by JMFC, he prayed for grant of bail.

Per contra, the State counsel has vehemently opposed the application stating that earlier applications of the applicant were dismissed on merits and since that dates, there is no change in circumstances.
Hence, considering the nature of offence, he prays for rejection of this bail application.
He further submits that as per letter of subordinate court No. 82/22, Jaura dated 10.2.2022, present case has been sent to the court of CJM, Morena and the trial is pending there.
Perused the record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the applicant is in custody since 4.1.2021 and there is no progress in trial and considering the custody period which is around Jagdish Dhakad vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 April, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68237129/
1 sixteen months, the application is allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rs. Two lac Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/Committal Court to appear before the Court on the dates given by the Concerned Court.
The applicant shall not commit any kind of offence.

In case of commission of any kind of offence, this bail order shall automatically stand cancelled and whole amount of bail bonds will be forfeited;
5.

The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused;
6. The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; and 7.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
A copy of this order be sent to the Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.

(RAJEEV KUMAR SHRIVASTAVA) JUDGE Rks RAM KUMAR SHARMA 2022.04.12 10:55:49 +05'30'
